LanguageData.CVG_Vow_Desc: Swear the {0} vow with {1}. While both cultivate close to each other, each cultivates {2} faster.
LanguageData.CVG_Vow_LetterText: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} have sworn the {2} vow before Heaven and Earth. From now on their paths are one.
LanguageData.CVG_Premonition_Text: {PAWN_nameDef} wakes up shaking: {PAWN_pronoun} has seen this before. {1} will attack in about {2} hours. There is still time to prepare.
LanguageData.CVG_SonOfHeaven_Used: Heaven is not done with {PAWN_nameDef}. The fatal blow missed by a hair, as if fate had moved it. (Recovers in {1} days.)
LanguageData.CVG_TraitUp_Text: Practice has paid off. {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer "{1}": {PAWN_pronoun} is now "{2}".
